name: lk.anybanq/anybanq
title: AnyBanQ — Sri Lankan banking products and card offers
description: Sri Lanka's bank loans, cards, card offers, FD and savings rates, branches and FX, from anybanq.lk

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the loans, cards, fixed deposits and savings accounts listed on anybanq.lk from Sri Lankan banks and finance companies. Filter by product type, bank and free-text words. sort=best puts the lowest loan rates, highest deposit rates and lowest card fees first.

kind.description: Product type. Leave out to search every type.

query.description: Words to match in the product name, bank or features, e.g. 'solar' or 'women'

bank.description: Bank or finance company name, short or full, e.g. 'Sampath' or 'BOC'

sort.description: best = cheapest loans / highest-paying deposits / lowest-fee cards first

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product listed on anybanq.lk: rates, fees, features, eligibility rules and documents needed, with the date AnyBanQ last verified them.

id.description: Product id: the number in the product's anybanq.lk URL, as returned by the other tools

kind.description: Product type, if known. Speeds the lookup.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 products listed on anybanq.lk side by side. For loans, give amount and tenure to get the indicative monthly instalment of each.

items.description: Product id: the number in the product's anybanq.lk URL, as returned by the other tools

amount.description: Loan amount in LKR, for instalments

tenureMonths.description: Loan tenure in months, for instalments

tools.name: fd_rates
tools.description: The highest fixed deposit rates in Sri Lanka for a tenure, one per bank or finance company, with interest earned after the 10% AIT withholding tax and the maturity value. Tenures: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 months.

months.description: Deposit tenure in months: one of 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60

senior.description: The depositor is 60 or older (adds senior-citizen deposits)

institutions.description: any = banks and finance companies; banks = licensed banks only; state = state banks only

tools.name: loan_rates
tools.description: Loans listed on anybanq.lk ranked by indicative monthly instalment for an amount and tenure (reducing balance, at each bank's published rate). Loans whose published maximum amount or tenure is below the request are flagged and ranked last.

tools.name: card_options
tools.description: Credit or debit cards listed on anybanq.lk, lowest annual fee first, with joining fee, interest rate, features and eligibility.

maxAnnualFeeLkr.description: Leave out cards with a higher published annual fee

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: An indicative, rule-based loan eligibility check. Uses AnyBanQ's referral minimums (monthly income LKR 100,000, amount LKR 100,000) and a debt-service ratio: (existing repayments + new instalment) / monthly income below 0.5 is likely, up to 0.65 borderline, above that unlikely. Returns the verdict per loan, the largest affordable loan, and each loan's own published eligibility rules. Never an approval.

existingRepaymentsLkr.description: Monthly repayments already being paid on other loans and leases, LKR

tools.name: list_banks
tools.description: Sri Lankan banks and finance companies listed on anybanq.lk, with type (state bank, private bank, finance company), contact number, website, branch count and profile page.

query.description: Part of the name, e.g. 'Hatton' or 'NDB'

tools.name: find_branches
tools.description: Bank branches and ATMs in Sri Lanka from the anybanq.lk locator, by bank and town. Returns address, phone and branch code.

tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka's daily indicative exchange rates, in LKR per unit of foreign currency. Optionally converts an amount. Banks' own buying and selling rates differ from these.

currencies.description: ISO codes, e.g. ['USD','GBP']. Leave out for all.

direction.description: to-lkr: amount is in the foreign currency; from-lkr: amount is in LKR

tools.name: unit_trusts
tools.description: Unit trust funds from the 16 wealth management companies licensed by the SEC Sri Lanka, as each manager publishes them: the SEC fund type, currency, minimum investment, management, entry and exit fees and trustee, with the manager's own fund page and factsheet. No returns, yields or unit prices: they change daily, so point the person to the fund page for them. Filter by type (money-market, gilt, income, balanced, growth, index, sector), manager, currency, Shariah, or the most the person can start with. With two or more funds, compareUrl opens the first four side by side on anybanq.lk. Unit trusts are not bank deposits; describe them, never recommend one.

category.description: SEC fund type. money-market and gilt hold short-term or government debt; growth is mostly equity

manager.description: Manager name or part of it, e.g. 'NDB', 'CAL', 'Senfin'

shariah.description: true: only funds the manager describes as Shariah compliant

maxMinimumLkr.description: Only funds whose published minimum investment is at most this many LKR

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search the card offers and discounts running today at shops, restaurants, hotels and online stores in Sri Lanka, from every bank on anybanq.lk. Ask in plain words (query 'shoes', 'dinner in Kandy', 'Keells', 'laptop online with Visa', 'black friday') and narrow by bank, category, card network, credit or debit, online, town or season. Results are ranked by how well they match, then by discount, with each offer's discount, bank, the cards it is for, end date and anybanq.lk page.

query.description: What the person wants, in their words: a thing to buy, a shop or brand, a place, e.g. 'shoes', 'buffet', 'Odel', 'hotel in Ella'

bank.description: Bank that issued the card, e.g. 'HNB', 'Commercial Bank', 'Sampath'

category.description: Offer category: dining (Dining), cafes-restaurants (Cafés & Restaurants), supermarkets (Supermarkets), hotels-leisure (Hotels & Leisure), travel (Travel), fashion (Fashion), home-lifestyle (Home & Lifestyle), online-shopping (Online Shopping), electronics (Electronics), health-wellness (Health & Wellness), beauty-salons (Beauty & Salons), jewellery (Jewellery), automobile (Automobile), education (Education), seasonal (Seasonal), e-wallets (E-Wallets), other (Other)

network.description: Card network the person pays with

online.description: true = only offers for shopping online

place.description: Town or Colombo area in Sri Lanka, e.g. 'Kandy', 'Kollupitiya', 'Colombo 7'

season.description: black-friday = usable over the Black Friday weekend to Cyber Monday; christmas = the banks' Christmas promotions

minDiscountPct.description: Only offers of at least this percentage off

sort.description: relevance = best match first (biggest discount first without a query)

tools.name: offers_near
tools.description: Card offers and discounts in or near a town or Colombo area in Sri Lanka, such as Kandy, Galle, Negombo, Kollupitiya or Colombo 7, from every bank on anybanq.lk. Give a place name, or a latitude and longitude in Sri Lanka. Returns the offers in that place, then the nearest ones around it with their distance, and nearby towns with offers.

place.description: Town or Colombo area, e.g. 'Kandy', 'Kollupitiya', 'Colombo 3', 'Nuwara Eliya'

lat.description: Latitude, with lon, when the person shares their location

category.description: Offer category: dining (Dining), cafes-restaurants (Cafés & Restaurants), supermarkets (Supermarkets), hotels-leisure (Hotels & Leisure), travel (Travel), fashion (Fashion), home-lifestyle (Home & Lifestyle), online-shopping (Online Shopping), electronics (Electronics), health-wellness (Health & Wellness), beauty-salons (Beauty & Salons), jewellery (Jewellery), automobile (Automobile), education (Education), seasonal (Seasonal), e-wallets (E-Wallets), other (Other)

bank.description: Bank that issued the card, e.g. 'HNB'

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one card offer running in Sri Lanka, as anybanq.lk lists it: the discount and its terms, every merchant, dates, and which of the bank's credit and debit cards qualify, with their anybanq.lk pages.

id.description: Offer id: the number in the offer's anybanq.lk URL (/offers/<id>-…), as returned by search_offers or offers_near

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Builds the anybanq.lk application link for a product, prefilled with amount and tenure. Takes no personal details and submits nothing: the person opens the link, reviews the form, verifies their identity and submits it themselves. Give the link to the person.

productId.description: Product id: the number in the product's anybanq.lk URL, as returned by the other tools

kind.description: Product type, when applying without a specific product

assistant.description: Name of the AI assistant creating the link, for attribution, e.g. 'claude'
